title: Nat Ford aerial processing contract (natford-aerial-processing.v1 / v1.1)
description: Service-level contract between a planning application (e.g. OpenPlan) and an ODM processing worker (the Aerial Intel Platform, or a self-hosted NodeODM worker). The consumer POSTs a ProcessingRequest to the worker's external processing endpoint; the worker processes the imagery through its NodeODM pipeline and POSTs ProcessingCallback payloads to the consumer's callbackUrl as the job advances. Both directions authenticate with a pre-shared bearer token. On a 'succeeded' callback the consumer writes its evidence record (OpenPlan: an aerial_evidence_packages row) from the artifacts list. This file is committed identically to both repositories; treat it as the single source of truth and bump schemaVersion for any breaking change. Revision v1.1 is ADDITIVE: it adds a second imagery type (photo_manifest — inline signed per-photo URLs), an ortho_preview artifact kind (a browser-consumable PNG rendering of the orthomosaic), and optional artifact georeferencing fields (boundsWgs84/crs/pixelSizeM). A request whose imagery is zip_url MUST still declare v1 — a v1-only worker receives byte-identical payloads and its strict validator never sees v1.1; a photo_manifest request MUST declare v1.1. Callbacks are accepted under either version.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key. Retried submissions with the same requestId must not create a second job.

callbackUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint on the consumer that receives ProcessingCallback payloads. Bearer-authenticated with the shared callback token.

presetId.description: Processing preset on the platform's NodeODM adapter.

then.description: A zip_url request MUST declare v1: a v1-only worker then receives byte-identical payloads and its strict validator never sees v1.1.
A photo_manifest request MUST declare v1.1 so a v1-only worker refuses it loudly instead of half-understanding it.

url.description: Signed, time-limited URL to a ZIP of source images. Must remain valid long enough for the platform's ingest cron to pull it.

PhotoManifestImagery.description: Contract v1.1. The source photos carried inline as signed, time-limited per-photo URLs minted by the consumer. Inline rather than a manifestUrl indirection: one fewer fetchable credential, and a 1,000-photo mission is roughly 300 KB of JSON.

url.description: Signed, time-limited URL to one source photo. Must remain valid long enough for the worker's ingest to pull it.

checksumSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the photo bytes. When present the worker MUST verify it after download and fail the job on mismatch, naming the file.

imageCount.description: MUST equal photos.length; carried explicitly so a truncated payload is detectable.

schemaVersion.description: Callbacks are accepted under either version: a v1 worker keeps sending v1 unchanged.

callbackId.description: Unique per delivery; consumers must dedupe on it (redeliveries are allowed).

status.description: Job lifecycle status, aligned with the platform's drone_processing_jobs.status vocabulary.

artifacts.description: Present when status is 'succeeded'. Each entry is a processed output the consumer can pull to build its evidence record.

kind.description: Canonical output kinds from the platform's real-output adapter. ortho_preview (v1.1) is a PNG rendering of the orthomosaic a browser can consume directly.

boundsWgs84.description: Optional (v1.1): [west, south, east, north] in WGS84, reprojected by the worker from the artifact's own GeoTIFF tags. Absent means the worker did not report georeferencing — the consumer must refuse to place the artifact on a map rather than inferring.

crs.description: Optional (v1.1): the NATIVE CRS of the artifact file as the worker read it (e.g. "EPSG:32610"). Provenance for boundsWgs84, which are already reprojected.

pixelSizeM.description: Optional (v1.1): ground pixel size in meters, as read from the artifact file.

benchmarkSummary.description: The platform's benchmark_summary.json for the run (schema owned by the platform; pass through opaque).
